levels.surface: عبد العزيز بن عبد الله بن أبي سلمة

notes: «عن عمه، الماجشون بن أبي سلمة»: «عمه» plus a name is one link, written as the name alone (rule 7). The first branch ends at ابن مهدي and the text writes no further names for it, so no shared tail. «بهذا الإسناد» closes the second route as a back_reference.
